# perfs

Umbrella for reusable client-side performance primitives — the home for the
shared substrate that measures and traces browser-side work (boot timing, and
future runtime perf instruments). Each member is a dependency-light primitive,
not a debug pane.

  - **`latency-signal`** — The closed vocabulary of client latency signals (update: a pushed change applied; confirm: an optimistic write confirmed), each a fixed tuple of named phases, as plain data; ClientLatencySample (a…
  - **`page-pauses`** — Was this page paused during a span of wall-clock time? pausesDuring(start, end): hidden or frozen at any point (visibilitychange, Page Lifecycle freeze), and how long its main thread was stalled…
  - **`scheduler`** — Main-thread scheduling primitives (yieldToMain: scheduler.yield → postTask → setTimeout(0)) for cooperative boot/work batching.
